package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CodeStructureTypeRepoPG implements repository.
type CodeStructureTypeRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts code structure type.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, structureType domain.CodeStructureType) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(
		ctx,
		`INSERT INTO code_structure_type (id, code, name, description, validator_service, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)`,
		structureType.ID,
		structureType.Code,
		structureType.Name,
		structureType.Description,
		structureType.ValidatorService,
		structureType.CreatedAt,
	)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

// Update updates existing code structure type.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, structureType domain.CodeStructureType) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(
		ctx,
		`UPDATE code_structure_type SET code=$1, name=$2, description=$3, validator_service=$4 WHERE id=$5`,
		structureType.Code,
		structureType.Name,
		structureType.Description,
		structureType.ValidatorService,
		structureType.ID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// Delete removes code structure type by id.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM code_structure_type WHERE id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// Get returns type by id.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, code, name, description, validator_service, created_at FROM code_structure_type WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var t domain.CodeStructureType
	if err := row.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Code, &t.Name, &t.Description, &t.ValidatorService, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &t, nil
}

// GetByID returns type by id.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	return r.Get(ctx, id)
}

// GetByCode returns type by code.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, code, name, description, validator_service, created_at FROM code_structure_type WHERE code=$1`, code)
	var t domain.CodeStructureType
	if err := row.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Code, &t.Name, &t.Description, &t.ValidatorService, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &t, nil
}

// List returns code structure types with pagination.
func (r CodeStructureTypeRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.CodeStructureTypeFilters) ([]domain.CodeStructureType, int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(filter.Page, filter.Limit)

	whereClause := ""
	args := []any{}
	argIdx := 1
	if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" {
		whereClause = "WHERE (code ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OR name ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OR description ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + ")"
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Query+"%")
		argIdx++
	}

	var total int
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) FROM code_structure_type " + whereClause
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, countQuery, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	query := "SELECT id, code, name, description, validator_service, created_at FROM code_structure_type " + whereClause + " ORDER BY code ASC LIMIT $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OFFSET $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var types []domain.CodeStructureType
	for rows.Next() {
		var t domain.CodeStructureType
		if err := rows.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Code, &t.Name, &t.Description, &t.ValidatorService, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		types = append(types, t)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return types, total, nil
}

var _ repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository = (*CodeStructureTypeRepoPG)(nil)
